t: You're looking at Kelham Rood, a sculpture of a statue made by Charles Sargeant Jagger. Jagger was a British sculptor who saw active service in the First World War, and he went on to make many works on the theme of war. He is best known for his war memorials, notably the Royal Artillery Memorial at Hyde Park Corner and the Great Western Railway War Memorial at Paddington station. I can't say more about this particular piece, but it comes from the same hand.
